claims.established: The source, qualification, runtime and final measurement receipts for admitted designs
claims.hypothesis: Mechanistic explanations or improvements require a separately registered follow-up
claims.not_established: Universal superiority, physical power reduction, industry-tool comparison, arbitrary scaling, four independent families
claims.observed: The stated single-seed, single-technology Pareto relations within admitted designs

classification_rule: Four-objective relative1e-10 dominance; primary balanced candidate retained; held designs never scored as PACT losses

PACT.candidate_selection: Existing balanced/best_E/best_H4/best_H8 role order, exact hash deduplication, maximum three before routing
PACT.objectives: Existing E/H4/H8 definitions, equal weights, operators and acceptance rules unchanged
PACT.physical_parameters: Existing frozen Nangate45 backend, clock/constraints, utilization, routing/DRC and timing-stage definitions; no per-design rescue
PACT.reference_rule: Existing minimum qualified routed scan cost among permitted B0/B1/B2/B3T, frozen before PACT search; ties follow existing deterministic ordering
PACT.workload: Existing frozen FAN collapsed-fault workload and exact settled-count activity definitions; preserve fault-class multiplicities, identity signatures and FF-Q replay

definitions.budget_bridge: Only frozen search seconds expression and its runtime-policy text changed to the already versioned 900s per loop; solver/evaluator/selection unchanged

B0.algorithm: Supplied source scan order split contiguously into balanced K=2 capacities; common original control

B1.algorithm: Native placed-cell greedy nearest neighbor; Boost Geometry Cartesian nearest uses Euclidean ranking; start minimizes x+y Manhattan distance to origin; no endpoint-inclusive local refinement

B2.algorithm: Established native FF-origin nearest neighbor followed by endpoint-inclusive symmetric Manhattan 2-opt, maximum 30 iterations

B3T.algorithm: Qualified patched OpenROAD K-means partition plus directed scan-pin Manhattan nearest neighbor and strict improving 2-opt/3-opt; external endpoints excluded by optimizer and included by common qualification

B4.algorithm: Existing phase0c A: global greedy balanced chain extensions minimizing mean load-PPI bit disagreement over the identical frozen FAN patterns; activity proxy, not exact E

B5.algorithm: Existing phase0c J50: global greedy balanced extensions of 0.5 normalized FF-origin Manhattan distance + 0.5 mean load-PPI disagreement
B5.normalization: distance / (x-span + y-span), or denominator 1 when zero
B5.starts: x/y/name sorted names at indices j*N//K

resource_policy.CPU_limits: One solver thread; fixed search worker 7200s. Physical route stage 1200s; existing FAN and compact workflow ceilings. Scaling ceiling failures retained rather than extending after outcome
resource_policy.larger_design_gate: Before each heavy stage require twenty GiB scratch PLUS max(five GiB, measured retained reference/candidate packages and remaining projected traces plus one observed complete-count-cache margin). Recalculate from admitted-design artifact dimensions; never reduce the floor to launch
resource_policy.margin_basis: Previous largest complete compact trace 482065653 bytes, per-role uncompressed counts up to 3193840720 bytes, retained packages and all receipts; at least five GiB beyond the existing twenty GiB workflow scratch gate
resource_policy.orchestration: Reuse atomic REGISTERED/STARTED/CHECKPOINTED/COMPLETED/FAILED/INTERRUPTED receipts, PID/boot/input/config/exit/resource evidence; external D raw paths and no Git bulk

definitions.scope: All preregistered cohort designs; no per-design weights or tuning
